0.name: TEXT_REGROC2LIGHTFEATHERPROVINGGROUNDS_00280_ALINAURE_000_000
0.description: Oh! Hello there. Welcome to the Lightfeather Proving Grounds.
0.translation_description: Oh! Ciao, che bello averti ai Campi di Prova di Piumaleggera.

3.name: TEXT_REGROC2LIGHTFEATHERPROVINGGROUNDS_00280_A1_000_002
3.description: What kind of place is this?

5.name: TEXT_REGROC2LIGHTFEATHERPROVINGGROUNDS_00280_ALINAURE_000_010
5.description: Officially, I'm supposed to show people around and answer their questions, but in practice, that's hardly necessary, as we rarely see new faces around here.
5.translation_description: In teoria dovrei accompagnare i visitatori e rispondere alle loro domande, ma in pratica non serve quasi mai: qui vediamo raramente facce nuove.

6.name: TEXT_REGROC2LIGHTFEATHERPROVINGGROUNDS_00280_ALINAURE_000_011
6.description: Not that I mind. I rather like being free to watch the fights.
6.translation_description: Non che mi dispiaccia. Mi piace poter assistere agli scontri.

7.name: TEXT_REGROC2LIGHTFEATHERPROVINGGROUNDS_00280_ALINAURE_000_020
7.description: As you might expect from the name, the Lightfeather Proving Grounds were originally established to host matches for battle-trained chocobos.
7.translation_description: Come suggerisce il nome, i Campi di Prova di Piumaleggera furono creati per ospitare gare tra chocobo addestrati al combattimento.

8.name: TEXT_REGROC2LIGHTFEATHERPROVINGGROUNDS_00280_ALINAURE_000_021
8.description: That being said, House Dzemael has since allowed the grounds to be used for other purposes on occasion.
8.translation_description: In seguito, la Casata Dzemael ha permesso che i campi venissero usati di tanto in tanto anche per altri scopi.

9.name: TEXT_REGROC2LIGHTFEATHERPROVINGGROUNDS_00280_ALINAURE_000_022
9.description: Some other houses have staged spectacles, for both private and public amusement. The Temple Knights have also held exhibitions in the past as well─those are always a delight, believe you me.
9.translation_description: Altre casate hanno organizzato spettacoli per divertire sia i privati sia il pubblico. In passato anche i Cavalieri del Tempio hanno tenuto delle esibizioni: quelle sì che sono uno spasso, te lo assicuro.
